title: Correct Main Display physical clock and weather-icon geometry
verify: Before any behavior write, obtain a fresh W31 physical RED on the connected and unlocked TECNO LI6 through only adb -s 1156725456009666. Record fresh wm size/orientation, app bounds, a full-screen screenshot and measured clock/icon/card geometry. The current status reports 2460x1080 as a prior observation, but execution must record the actual current value rather than assume it. The existing W30 host receipts and prior smoke screenshot are baseline context only and cannot satisfy W31 RED/GREEN.

Run a fresh host geometry probe at the resolved physical landscape size and at 1280x720 using deterministic redacted fixtures. The probe must measure the complete HH:mm bounds, available clock region, each weather illustration footprint, card bounds/order and the three right-side timer-control bounds. A host result may support geometry but cannot replace the physical visual claim.

If physical RED is confirmed, correct only Main Display presentation geometry in DisplayCapability.kt with focused DisplayProjectionTest.kt support: make the complete HH:mm the largest/readable focal element fully contained in the actual device landscape area; materially reduce weather-icon scale so icons are secondary and do not dominate their cards; preserve the existing adaptive/relative geometry without inventing a fixed product ratio unless routed to /feature-doctor FT-001.

Preserve the four stable weather slots in yesterday/today/tomorrow/day_after order across NO_DATA, partial and populated redacted fixtures; keep city/date in the left column above Yesterday; keep the large clock in the free upper/central area above the three day cards; and keep the three timer controls separate on the right with existing labels/order/touch behavior.

Obtain fresh claim-equivalent GREEN on the same unlocked TECNO LI6 serial and resolved landscape size after the correction, with before/after screenshots and a geometry receipt. GREEN requires complete HH:mm with no clipping/overflow, clock dominance over weather icons, materially reduced non-dominant icons, preserved date/city and timer separation, and no card-slot disappearance or layout shift. If the target is locked, disconnected or otherwise unavailable, stop without PASS and record DEFERRED; do not substitute host-only evidence.

Run the host gates and a named Reviewer/visual-QA rubric against the physical and host receipts. The rubric must record PASS/FAIL and decisive observations for clock dominance/readability, full-string containment, reduced icon scale, four-slot stability, date/city placement, timer separation and honest host/device separation.

Prove by static/boundary review that the task only consumes the existing Weather Context projection and Timer & Alert presentation: no provider, refresh, freshness, cache/history, normalized data, timer lifecycle, control dispatch, fullscreen owner, runtime wiring or public contract changes.

Do not start or use an emulator, AVD or QEMU. Do not use another device serial, a locked target, network/provider calls or credentials. Stop and route to /feature-doctor FT-001 if a fixed dp/font/ratio or numeric icon target is required; stop and route to /spec-design if ownership, module, edge, public contract or runtime ownership must change.
